title: windows: reduce excessive context-switching degrading throughput
scenario: On windows, a hard operational problem: Un carico soffre di context-switching eccessivo che degrada il throughput. Individua la causa (troppi thread / lock contention) e riduci lo switching. Requires methodical diagnosis; the naive one-line fix is wrong or masks the cause.
initial_state: # fixture: windows host prepared for 'reduce excessive context-switching degrading throughput'
expected_reasoning: High involuntary context switches point at oversubscription or lock contention, not raw CPU shortage.
Measure voluntary vs involuntary switches and thread counts vs cores.
Right-size concurrency / fix the contended lock; verify throughput improves as switching drops.
expected_commands: # windows-appropriate diagnostic + fix sequence for: reduce excessive context-switching degrading throughput
safety_constraints: Diagnose before acting; no blind reboots/kills.
Least-privilege, reversible change; capture prior state.
Do not mask the symptom or weaken security.
success_criteria: The 'reduce excessive context-switching degrading throughput' problem is genuinely resolved (root cause fixed and verified), not masked.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Capture prior state before changing it; every step is reversible if recorded.
possible_mistakes: Add CPUs when the wall is lock contention.
hints: Threads >> cores is a red flag.
alternative_solution: Pin threads / use a thread pool sized to cores to cut switching.
edge_cases: A busy-wait spinlock burns CPU without showing as blocking.
goal: Un carico soffre di context-switching eccessivo che degrada il throughput. Individua la causa (troppi thread / lock contention) e riduci lo switching.
